items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: you worked around New York with all these people like Wilbur DeParis, Tony Parenti (Dreher)... Yes. (Carandi?).

ctx.x: Now there's one thing, I just wonder was whether you wanted to say a little bit about the last few years? You worked around New York with all these people like Wilbur DeParis, Tony Parenti (Dreher), Max Kaminsky and you went down to New Orleans in June '69 to play at the Jazz Fest?
